prompt_md: At a fair, you toss a coin 2 cm across onto a grid of 5 cm squares (thin lines). It lands at a random spot. Chance it lies fully inside a square, touching no line?
prompt_short: 2 cm coin on a 5 cm grid. Chance it touches no line?
hint_md: Where can the coin's center land?
explain_intuition_md: The coin's center must stay 1 cm from every line, so it has to land in a 3 cm by 3 cm patch in the middle of a 5 cm square. That's 9 out of 25 square centimeters. Thinking in one direction (3 of 5) gives 60%, but both directions must work.
